text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Use shared decision-making to choose monotherapy for uncomplicated major depression; patient prefers medication over psychotherapy
  • Start sertraline 50 mg daily; review expected time to benefit, common adverse effects, and how to reach the clinic
  • Repeat PHQ-9 at six and twelve weeks and adjust treatment if response is inadequate; plan continuation treatment after remission
  • Create a collaborative safety plan with crisis resources, including the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
  • Psychiatry consultation to confirm the diagnosis and advise on medication management
